bio: BA, Stanford University MDiv, Harvard Divinity School Aisha Ansano is an ordained Unitarian Universalist minister and co-founder of Nourish UU , which supports Unitarian Universalist in cultivating thriving, embodied ministries in their communities. She also serves as the affiliated community minister at First Parish in Malden, Massachusetts, where she lives with her partner and their puppy, Nyx. Leslie MacPherson Affiliation Denominational Counselor Alpha Grouping A-E
